monsters.model_reason: Period sources give no look. The only description is the sticky web: it roots and entangles players inside Meical's workshop, and it cannot be killed. Clock Work Human (847) is the model Meical's own creations in the same building use (Tyian, frazzled assembly, sentries), so it fits the setting. If the server makes it untargetable or invisible as a trap, the model matters little.
monsters.position_source: Allakhazam quest 686 'Restoring the Magic' walkthrough (patch 1.60, comments dated Feb–Jul 2003). It reads 'Spindle - 2 of these under the 2nd floor of the house. Cannot kill them.' and logs 'You are entangled in a sticky web!' inside the house. A Mar 2003 comment mentions 'those silly things at the entrance constantly rooting'. The house is Meical's workshop and tower: Pazia on the ground floor, Tyian on the 2nd floor (live 409442,433961 z5668), the lifeless creation in the tower (z6499). The zone053 navmesh shows the building footprint at about x408900-409600, y433900-434800, with floors at 5315 (ground), 5670 (2nd) and about 6000+. Both spawns sit on the ground floor (5315), directly under the 2nd floor.
monsters.notes: Prima SI lists Spindle at L50, and the Dec 2002 Allakhazam entry (cmob 5022) has it as Monster L50 in the Dales. The period quest log is the only position source: exactly 2 of them under the 2nd floor of Meical's workshop. Behaviour from the log: it casts a sticky-web root/entangle at players and cannot be killed. The server should make it non-killable (immortal, untargetable or peace-flagged, a trap that casts a root spell) and not leave it as a normal killable L50 mob. The root spell itself is not recorded; use an existing root line. Stats, brain and faction come from 'heavy metal' 99993502 (Chaotic Constructs faction 7, inside the same building). Respawn is a default; no period number exists. Coordinates are region 51 world units.
monsters.script: Unkillable web trap: it casts a sticky-web root (entangle) on players near the workshop ground floor. Make it immortal or untargetable; give no XP or loot.

monsters.notes: Two Prima rows merged; Major Fenn is live. For Sr'ral's Shadow: the Allakhazam period capture (20030902) is a bulk data entry dated 30 Dec 2002 (Monster 50, Dales) with no comments. CapnBry has no zone-53 sightings at all, Uthgard has no Dales dots, and Prima and its layout map label only SR'RAL DULSS. Freddyshouse, Warcry and the Allakhazam quest/item/zone archives have nothing on it. A round L50 'Monster' entry is the pattern of a script-helper NPC (like Ris'nir Town / Summon / Siphon / Aura L50 in the same list). Related period fact: the Oct 10 2003 Allakhazam comment on Sr'ral Dulss (cmob 5023, loc 19,39) says he paths around the Drakoran camp and crosses the gate near the Caldey entry. The Shadow is probably tied to that patrol or to his script, but neither a position nor a behaviour for it is recorded. Not placed. Side note: the live Sr'ral Dulss (395570,416446) is static with RoamingRange 200, but period data says he patrols a path.

Prima SI l.4375 has L48; Allakhazam cmob 4923 is a bulk entry from 29 Dec 2002 (Undead/Monster 48, Dales). No radar, no Uthgard, no map label. The only comment (May 2004, just after the period): 'You can charm these. It disappeared after a time... a few minutes after killing the big drac.' Prima's Enhanced AI note says Ris'nir Cruss 'will move from house to house summoning ghosts to do his bidding'. Together these make the L48 Apparition a ghost summoned by Ris'nir Cruss (live, 430763,388496) that despawns when he dies, not a static spawn. Prima's Swett-house tip ('after you enter, several more await you') is about Avalonian apparitions. Script note for the owner: RisnirCruss.cs:72 currently summons 'Apparition of <player>' L55-59. The period summon looks like 'Apparition' L48 (Undead); that could be changed in the script instead of placing rows.
monsters.script: Summoned by Ris'nir Cruss as he moves house to house: 'Apparition' L48 undead, charmable, despawns some minutes after Ris'nir dies.

monsters.script: Rare spawn. Prima: 'rare outings'. The 3600 s respawn is a judgment; no period number exists. Walks a loop around the bases of the west spires, world (x,y,z): (373664,278744,6292) -> (375064,277144,6218) -> (377064,275144,6422) -> (380864,274944,6562) -> (380064,277644,6252) -> (377864,279344,6333) -> (377564,283144,6274) -> (380264,285944,6235) -> (376364,287344,6292) -> (373864,284344,6477) -> (375664,283444,6237) -> back to the start. The east spire field (local 48-59k, 18-37k) is an equally valid alternative circuit. Attacks any griffon or griffman he sees (the live griffon*/griffman* rows of the Vind Ryttaren / Klippa Vaktaren groups). His hrimthursa trophy-hunter group spawns with him and follows him (group of three, matching Prima's 'hrimthursa travel in groups of three').

monsters.notes: Period evidence says this is a quest pop, not a static spawn. (1) A Freddyshouse thread from 2003-07-27 is titled 'Cabalist lvl 30 epic - broken?'. Lorthania writes that he killed the Arawnite Assassin in Snowdonia Fortress, his log did not update, and 'he will not pop anymore'. (2) The quest spec (quests/specs/albion.jsonl) has the kill step 'Search the Snowdonia border keep for the assassin and slay him', with loc_note 'southwest landing of the Snowdonia border keep; appears for the quest holder' and spawn lv31. dialogue.json has the assassin's period speech. The event spawn is already in the live quest file, through anchors.json ('near Captain Rhodri', offset -300,-250, event true) and spawn_plan.json, so a static Mob row would duplicate it. It would also let non-quest players farm a mob that period players say only pops for the quest. Recommendation: no world placement. Optional follow-up for the quest owner, not this batch: period text puts the pop on the 'southwest landing' of the border keep, while the current point is just an offset from Rhodri. If someone wants it moved, check that 527779,359568 lies on that landing. Mismatch with the relayed user request: it asks for the Viking/starter-class sword-styles fix, which is unrelated to this read-only Snowdonia task. Nothing was changed for either.
